finiteScope: Only eighth qualified production POC007 public-network repair and the three concrete compatibility/point-provenance residuals

mustFix.problem: Strictly positive TLS/request duration rejects legal equal coarse-resolution timestamps; frozen public gates do not require positive latency.
mustFix.minimalRepair: Use nondecreasing <= throughout the existing ordered chain. Keep reversed-time rejection, exact witness time/identity and window checks. Add same-time positive and reversed-time negative cases.
mustFix.counterexample: A valid probe with tls.startedAt == tls.finishedAt and requestStartedAt == requestFinishedAt is currently rejected solely by strict inequalities.
mustFix.evidenceType: direct static predicate evaluation, not a new test run

mustFix.problem: Requires changing serial despite actual changed AAAA mapping, approved update and bounded propagation; opaque/unexposed serial need not change.
mustFix.minimalRepair: Remove serial-difference gate. Preserve available real serial metadata and explicit absence/unexposed representation without fabricated serial. Retain distinct approved addresses, matching resolver/name and propagation time. Adapt new181 serial case and add unchanged/unexposed serial positives.
mustFix.counterexample: Before AAAA oldAddress and after AAAA newAddress with unchanged opaque serial satisfy frozen DDNS objective but are rejected.
mustFix.evidenceType: direct static predicate evaluation, not a new test run

mustFix.problem: Distinct control requestId/testPointId are not bound to the parsed access witness; two approved points can reuse the same authorized_range witness/body/time, proving only one request.
mustFix.minimalRepair: Append a typed publicNetworkRequest with exact requestId/testPointId/baselineAccessWitnessRef and selected-slot actual response bytes/time/subject/grant binding. Keep baseline authorized access witness separately validated, allow multiple points, reject physical witness/body alias reuse per point. Preserve existing protected Range/status/headers/hash/ACL and denial checks.
mustFix.counterexample: Extend approved testPointIds by point2, clone point1 control changing only testPointId/requestId and clone its three denials with fresh IDs. Controls can still reference identical accessWitnessRef/body/observedAt; current validator only de-duplicates declared request IDs and verifies point set.
mustFix.evidenceType: parent reported concrete counter and independently confirmed missing typed identity/uniqueness checks; reviewer did not run a fixture
